body:
Founder real-time: write kubernetes primitives into the stdlib and write helm support into parena both in the stdlib and also into DUNG and project BURROW -> helm primatives. k8s.prn: real defstructs (Container/Deployment/ServiceSpec/PVCSpec) + YAML emission, matching PRRJECT_FATBABY's real dashboard.yaml resource shapes. helm.prn: Chart defstruct + chart-yaml/values-yaml/templated-deployment-yaml. Verified end-to-end via a real C test harness, all pass; a real Helm chart generated into PRRJECT_FATBABY/charts/dashboard/. scaling.prn: scalar-only companion (k8s.prn/helm.prn are String+Arena-based, incompatible with burrow's GC-off-safe Go target) -- compiles through both C and Go targets, proving BURROW's new defstruct support. PARENA commit 694e658.

⚓ ☃
title: stdlib/k8s + stdlib/helm — real Kubernetes + Helm primitives
